profile.name: 热循环仪
profile.description: 用于 PCR 等热循环实验的通用热循环仪，支持加热块与热盖温度控制、开合盖、运行多阶段温控程序，并查询当前温度、循环进度与运行状态。
profile.description_en: A generic thermocycler for PCR and other thermal cycling workflows. It supports block and heated-lid temperature control, lid open/close operations, execution of multi-stage temperature protocols, and queries of current temperature, cycle progress, and run status.
